reason: A web UI plugin that highlights sessions awaiting input or completed while unattended using a frame badge, tab-title count, and favicon color changes.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中通过徽章、标签页计数和鲸鱼图标颜色提醒用户关注等待输入或已完成的会话。
summaries.en: Adds web UI attention indicators—a frame badge, tab-title count, and recolored whale favicon—for sessions awaiting input or completed while unattended.

capabilities: Reads session status and counts from the built-in sessions store
Displays attention badges and status colors in the web interface
Updates the browser tab title and favicon based on session state
